images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A deckbuilder battle screen rendered as an open botanical herbarium sheet on a dark wooden desk, 16:9, flat top-down page with slight paper curl. Cream laid paper with brown foxing spots and soft grain; everything drawn in faded teal-green ink and sepia: a moonlit field as a watercolor wash, a wooden fence protecting small garden beds on the left, a roe deer intruder drawn in fine ink line on the right with a red rubber-stamp style intent tag, a ghosted hatched boar waiting behind. Bottom: a fanned hand of five specimen cards, each a real pressed plant (sprout, bramble with red berries, broad leaves, dried seed pods) sewn to the card with white thread stitches, a typed herbarium label, a red circled cost stamp and a handwritten note of what it becomes if sown. Right: a seed-envelope shaped sowing tray with five plot slots, two already holding kept specimens with next-year forecasts, three dashed empty slots. Warm lamp light, gentle vignette. Korean UI: "겨울 하룻밤", "파종함", "남겨 심기".

images.screen: B — 봄 · 돋아남: 남겨 심은 표본이 자라 돌아오는 순간 (Spring, sown specimens return transformed)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same herbarium-sheet game in spring morning, 16:9, soft sunlight from the upper left, a few pale green petals drifting across the page. Center-left: a hand-drawn top-down garden plan of six ruled soil plots with sepia hatching; three plots have bold teal borders and dark labels marking them as bound by last winter's sown cards, where pressed specimens have visibly grown into larger forms (a dense thicket, a two-stem bramble with red berries, burst seed pods leaving three red seeds); one plot newly planted, one empty, one locked with diagonal hatching. A red double-line stamp reads victory at the top. Right: a small ledger of seeds and water drops and the coming winter deck list with tiny plant icons. Bottom: a lineage strip showing one specimen across three years, small plant, then sown, then a much fuller plant, arrows between, handwritten annotations. Palette cream, teal ink, sepia, muted leaf green, one stamp red. Korean UI: "봄 · 돋아남", "계보", "묶임 2턴". Text constraints: the red double-line stamp at the top reads the Korean word "승리" only; no English words anywhere in the UI.
